messages:
Casey: FYI planning to land docs PR #587 (migration + Go SDK snippet) in the 14:00 docs merge window. Vercel preview shows correct pages but Netlify preview is serving stale assets. Can reviewers still approve?
Priya: Stale assets are usually CDN caching on Netlify side. If Vercel preview is green and local `mkdocs build` matches, we can approve content but gate the merge until we confirm final preview.
Luis: docs-bot reports two previews: 
docs-bot: Vercel preview: https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/deployments/1998761200 (succeeded)
docs-bot: Netlify preview: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1998761188 (succeeded, but serving older assets)
Omar: Quick triage: run `mkdocs build` and validate the generated `site/` content hash. If local build matches Vercel, it's safe to approve content now.
Casey: Running local smoke:
```
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
mkdocs build --clean
sha256sum -b site/assets/* | sort > local-hashes.txt
```
Local hashes align with the Vercel deploy artifacts. Netlify seems to be returning an older CDN version.
Priya: I'll do a content pass now. Quick things to check: heading levels, code fence languages, and that the Go snippet imports the right module path (redwood.dev/go).
Luis: I checked links in the migration guide; one external link to a partner blog redirects and we should point to the canonical URL. Leaving an inline comment.
Priya: Minor nit fixed in the PR. Go snippet imports `github.com/redwood-inference/go` instead of `redwood.dev/go` 1 changed that and pushed.
docs-bot: New Netlify deploy attempt triggered: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1998761455 (in progress). Logs: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1998761455#logs
Omar: Approve for content in-thread. I will not gate the merge on Netlify if maintainers are okay with `merge: gated` to allow CI to finish after the commit.
Casey: Approvals noted: Omar approved, Priya approved. If Netlify preview still serves stale assets after redeploy, maintainers should wait 10 minutes for CDN invalidation or use `merge: maintainer` as last resort.
Luis: Also a local preview tip for contributors: if you see asset mismatches, run `mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8000` and open the page in an incognito window to avoid browser cache. Posting the snippet in the PR comment.
docs-bot: Netlify deploy 1998761455 completed: status - succeeded, but cache headers present; may take up to 8 minutes to propagate.
Casey: Given approvals, I'll hold off exactly 8 minutes then check the live Netlify preview. If it shows the updated assets we merge at 14:10; otherwise we wait or use maintainer merge.
Priya: Quick checklist before merge: 1) approvals in thread, 2) docs CI green or merge label set to `merge: gated`, 3) no unresolved blocking comments.
Luis: All good from link and asset side now.
Omar: Spot-checked Vercel and local build again. LGTM.
Casey: Netlify live preview now shows updated assets. Merging at 14:11. Commit message: `docs: migrate Go SDK example (#587) 1 docs-release`.
Priya: Thanks all 1 I'll add a short note to the release-notes doc about the Go SDK example and the CDN caveat.
Luis: I'll open a tiny follow-up PR to add a note to CONTRIBUTING.md about the local-cache troubleshooting commands.
Casey: Merged at 14:11. Closing thread.
